GD 1S.name: First-Year Seminar in Graphic Design
GD 1S.description: Introductory seminar for first-year Graphic Design majors.

GD 101.name: Design Foundation
GD 101.description: Foundational studio course introducing core design principles and processes.

GD 107.name: Graphic Design Studio - Components
GD 107.description: Studio course exploring the fundamental components of graphic design. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 101.

GD 110.name: User Experience Design: Concepts and Principles
GD 110.description: Introduction to user experience design concepts and principles.

GD 115N.name: Visualizing Information
GD 115N.description: Principles and practice of visualizing complex information.

GD 201.name: Typography
GD 201.description: Studio course on typographic principles and practice. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 107.

GD 202W.name: The History of Graphic Design
GD 202W.description: Survey of the history of graphic design.

GD 207.name: Graphic Design Studio - Products
GD 207.description: Studio course exploring designed products. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 201.

GD 210.name: User Interface Design and Prototyping
GD 210.description: User interface design methods and prototyping techniques. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 110.

GD 211.name: Design Photo and Motion
GD 211.description: Studio course exploring photography and motion in design. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 107.

GD 300.name: Design Photography
GD 300.description: Advanced studio course in design photography. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 201.

GD 307.name: Graphic Design Studio - Systems
GD 307.description: Studio course exploring design systems. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 207.

GD 308.name: Graphic Design Seminar
GD 308.description: Seminar in graphic design theory and practice. Bulletin requires GD 307 concurrent at enrollment.

GD 315.name: Humanizing Data
GD 315.description: Advanced studio course in data visualization and information design. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 115N and GD 207.

GD 320.name: Interaction Design
GD 320.description: Advanced studio course in interaction design. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 210.

GD 400.name: Time and Sequence
GD 400.description: Advanced studio course exploring time-based and sequential design. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 307.

GD 407.name: Graphic Design Studio - Communities
GD 407.description: Studio course exploring design for communities. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 307.

GD 409.name: Exhibition and Portfolio
GD 409.description: Capstone course preparing a professional exhibition and portfolio. Bulletin requires a C or better in GD 407.

GD 495.name: Internship
GD 495.description: Supervised internship experience. Bulletin credit range is 1-18 and the plan schedules three separate 1-credit enrollments; modeled at 1cr for the first literal enrollment (additional enrollments are generic repeat slots, since a completed course can't satisfy a second literal item in this engine).
